_note: The pinned ComfyUI build, the same one Love Live Studio installs (its kit/manifest.json). kit/setup.ps1 reads this.

modern.for: NVIDIA RTX 20/30/40/50 series and GTX 16 series (compute capability 7.5 or newer)

pascal.for: NVIDIA GTX 10 series and older (compute capability below 7.5), e.g. GTX 1070
pascal.torch: 2.14.1+cu126, Python 3.12 (PyTorch 2.14 is the last release that supports Pascal; never upgrade torch here)
pascal.note: NVIDIA driver branch 580 is the last one for GTX 10 series; 580.x is fine.

7zr.for: unpacking the engine when Windows' own tar cannot (Windows 10's tar has no LZMA support)
